Hi Emily —

Thanks for the invite and the context. I want to flag that I'm traveling on Dec 7 and — more importantly — our engineering team would like a little extra time to prepare with your sample prompts and traces so we can make the demo specific to your workload. Would it be possible to move the live demo to one of these slots instead:

- Thu, Dec 9 at 10:00 AM PT
- Fri, Dec 10 at 9:00 AM PT or 2:00 PM PT

To make the session most valuable, can you share the following ahead of the call (we'll treat anything you send as confidential):
- Representative prompt set (CSV / text) with expected temperature / decoding settings
- Workload traces: typical sequence lengths, tokens per request, concurrency/QPS estimates
- A small sample dataset or S3 path (or secure share) we can use for the demo
- Point of contact for SSO/IDP provisioning if you want SSO for the private demo tenant

I'll loop in Dev (cc) to handle the technical prep; Rishi will join for pricing and contract-level questions. If you can't shift the date, we can still run on Dec 7 but will do a higher-level overview.

Thanks — appreciate the flexibility.

Best,
Marissa Cole

A couple of quick tech requests so we can prep the environment and avoid last-minute blockers:
- Preferred delivery for sample data: S3 presigned URL or SFTP. If S3, please share bucket/path and a short-lived IAM role/presigned URL.
- Schema/columns for the prompt CSV (if you have one-line descriptions of columns, that helps us map tokenization).
- Typical concurrency and expected peak QPS — helps us size batching and KV cache config.
- Any PII classification notes for the sample dataset.

I'll put together a short prep checklist and attach it here (prep_checklist.md). Dev & Lauren will run a dry-run on Dec 8 to validate the demo notebook and example prompts. If Procurement needs anything from Redwood (NDA / SOC2), point them to our security page: https://redwood.com/security/soc2-report
